::: {#exm-wrong-guess}
#### A guess that fails

The sequence of @exr-triple-plus-power-check starts $e_0 = 1$, $e_1 = 5$,
which are $5^0$ and $5^1$.
So one might guess $e_n = 5^n$.
The guess fails at $n = 2$, since $e_2 = 19$ and $5^2 = 25$.

An attempt to prove the guess by induction (@def-proof-by-induction) shows where it goes wrong.
Supposing $e_k = 5^k$, the recurrence relation gives

$$
\ba
e_{k + 1}
&= 3 e_k + 2^{k + 1}
\\&= 3 \cdot 5^k + 2^{k + 1},
\ea
$$

and the inductive step needs this to equal $5^{k + 1} = 5 \cdot 5^k$, which happens only when $2^{k + 1} = 2 \cdot 5^k$, that is, only when $k = 0$.

:::
